content_sections.heading: CERC Senior Advisor Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.central_electricity_regulatory_commissio: Maximum consolidated fee of Rs. 2,50,000 per month (excluding GST, if applicable)
B.Tech and minimum 2 years MBA/ PG Diploma course from a reputed institution/ University, with post-qualification working experience of not less than fifteen years in the Power Sector/Regulatory body
Below 62 years (as on 1st January of the year of advertisement)
Dy. Chief (Admin), Central Electricity Regulatory Commission, 8th Floor, Tower-B, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110029

content_sections.heading: CERC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ADMN-11017/6/2024-CERC-Part(1) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CERC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Should be conversant with the regulatory framework in the power sector of India, Indian Electricity Act-2003, National Tariff Policy, National Electricity Policy Experience/knowledge of preparation of Reports/Orders pertaining to the power sector Good communication and analytical skills with proficiency in MS Office Tools, specially MS Word and MS Excel No Consultant would be retained in the Commission after attaining the age of 65 years Desirable: Experience of working in Electricity Regulatory Commissions shall have added advantage

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CERC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Retired Government/PSU consultants already availing medical facilities under any Government medical scheme are not eligible for reimbursement of medical insurance premium

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fee commensurate with academic qualifications, total experience, domain expertise and knowledge required for the deliverables. Initially for one year; extended for a further three years on satisfactory performance May then be extended up to a maximum of two years, limited to a total of six years Annual escalation up to 10% on the fee may be given in deserving cases with approval of the Chairperson Purely contract basis; no right to claim regular or continued contractual appointment Terminable by either party with three months' notice or equivalent remuneration in lieu

content_sections.heading: How Will CERC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Eligibility considered by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee (CEC) Evaluation on technical parameters and preparation of a panel of candidates Interaction of short-listed candidates with the Selection Committee Written test at the discretion of the CEC Academic background and relevant experience for the assignment - weight 0.50 Drafting skill of the consultant - weight 0.30 Knowledge of the working environment such as language, culture, administrative system - weight 0.20 CEC prepares a panel of candidates and carries out the selection process thereafter Only short-listed candidates called for interaction with the Selection Committee CEC may conduct a written test to evaluate drafting and presentation skills

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Recent passport size colour photo on the form Self-attested copies of academic certificates from tenth standard onwards Self-attested copies of experience certificates and salary slips in chronological order Separate sheet signed by the candidate if space is insufficient Statement of about 100 words on why you want this role and are suitable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CERC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format at Annexure-I enclosed with the notice. Attach self-attested copies of certificates, experience certificates and salary slips in chronological order. Submit it to the Dy. Chief (Admin), CERC, 8th Floor, Tower-B, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110029. Applications can also be sent by email at [email protected] . Applications must be received by 5.00 PM on 8th December, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications not in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) are liable to be rejected Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will be summarily rejected without communication Relaxation in essential qualifications/experience can be considered in deserving cases at CERC's discretion CERC reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the positions Engagement governed by CERC (Appointment of Consultants) Regulation, 2010, available on www.cercind.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Advisor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I enclosed with the notice (pages 8-9)) and send it to Dy. Chief (Admin), Central Electricity Regulatory Commission, 8th Floor, Tower-B, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110029, by to the dy. chief (admin) at the cerc address, or by email, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 62 years (as on 1st January of the year of advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Maximum consolidated fee of Rs. 2,50,000 per month (excluding GST, if applicable).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Tech and minimum 2 years MBA/ PG Diploma course from a reputed institution/ University, with post-qualification working experience of not less than fifteen years in the Power Sector/Regulatory body.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Should be conversant with the regulatory framework in the power sector of India, Indian Electricity Act-2003, National Tariff Policy, National Electricity Policy. Experience/knowledge of preparation of Reports/Orders pertaining to the power sector. Good communication and analytical skills with proficiency in MS Office Tools, specially MS Word and MS Excel. No Consultant would be retained in the Commission after attaining the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Government/PSU consultants already availing medical facilities under any Government medical scheme are not eligible for reimbursement of medical insurance premium.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligibility considered by the Consultancy Evaluation Committee (CEC). Evaluation on technical parameters and preparation of a panel of candidates. Interaction of short-listed candidates with the Selection Committee. Written test at the discretion of the CEC.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for one year; extended for a further three years on satisfactory performance. May then be extended up to a maximum of two years, limited to a total of six years. Annual escalation up to 10% on the fee may be given in deserving cases with approval of the Chairperson.
